title: Custom methods
excerpt: Custom methods A custom method is a JSON RPC method outside the MCP specification. Prefix it with a vendor namespace — acme/search, never a bare search — so it can never collide with a spec method. Handle a vendor prefixed method on the server setRequestHandler lives on the low level Server, reached from an McpServer as mcp.server.
